Card Q&A.q: Which player chooses whether or not a card is trashed and chooses the card to trash for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving]effect?
When an effect plays an opponent's Digimon into the breeding area, does this card's inherited effect activate?
Does this card's inherited effect also activate when one of my effects plays an opponent's Digimon?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Your opponent may trash 1 Digimon card in their hand. If they don't, gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] While your opponent has no Digimon, this Digimon can't attack.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an effect plays an opponent's Digimon, gain 1 memory.
